passages.provision_quote: any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F, and the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
passages.note: Enacted text requires documentary proof of citizenship at registration, matching rung 5's clause.
House Third Reading roll call shows Pingerelli voting Y on final passage, with 26 No votes against 31 Yes.

rows.reasoning: Pingerelli voted Y on final passage of HB2492 (2022), a single-subject voter registration/citizenship bill whose enacted text requires any registration application be 'accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship,' matching the rung text 'Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote.' The vote was not near-unanimous (31-26-3-0-0), and the act falls within her service as State Representative, the same office she holds now.
